text:
Rafael P: Kicking off a phased rollout of v2 on the edge-bridge (ap-southeast-1) tonight 2026-03-21 23:30 UTC. Plan: 2m internal canary -> 5% for 30m -> 25% -> full over 120m. v1 fallback stays enabled for first 2h.
Joan C: Quick Q: any tenants pinned to v1 we should exclude? I'll DM a list if needed.
Ivy L: Note: old desktop SDKs (<=1.6.0) lowercase `x-client-version` and sometimes omit `Accept` header, which hits strict routes. Recommend mentioning `x-compat-mode: v1` as a workaround in notes.
sam-deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Rafael P for 2026-03-21T23:30:00Z to cluster ap-southeast-1. Steps: canary -> gradual-shift -> validate -> finalize. Auto-rollback on: error_rate > 2.5% over 3m OR 5xx uplift > 1.5% absolute.
ops-night: I'll be on watch 23:10-01:30 UTC. Adding `edge.v2.error_rate.p3m` and `edge.v2.p95_latency` to paging rules.
Joan C: Can we gate requests missing `x-client-version` to v1 for first 15m? That avoids noisy noise from not-yet-updated clients.
Ivy L: I pushed a small header-normalize shim to the bridge that accepts case-insensitive keys. Deployed to the canary image.
sam-deploy-bot: Canary applied at 23:28 UTC to 15 internal keys (header `x-cutover-test`). Report: 0 errors; median latency +3ms.
ops-night: Canary looks clean. No new 4xx/422 spikes in the first 2m. Ready for 5% at 23:30.
Rafael P: Operator notes: if latency p95 increases > 180ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows escalate to eng-runtime. Manual fallback flip (ops VPN only): `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/route/edge-bridge/fallback?action=enable -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>"`. To disable: `action=disable`.
Ivy L: Also temporarily relax burst rate limiter for routes `/v2/*` during ramp to avoid 429 noise: `ratelimit.edge.v2.burst=200` for 60m.
product-comm: I'll add an explicit compat paragraph to the release notes and link to docs/compatibility#edge-bridge about `x-compat-mode`. Will also call out SDK versions that may need a patch.
Joan C: Logging opt-out tenants now. If any tenant reports schema 422s, pause and flip fallback.
sam-deploy-bot: 5% shift started at 23:30 UTC. Monitoring windows: 5m, 15m, 30m.
ops-night: Observed a small uptick in 4xx from one instance at 23:35 (6 extra reqs/min) — investigating traces.
Ivy L: Traces show a single tenant sending invalid JSON in `input` field; not a platform regression. Tagging tenant and contacting support.
Rafael P: OK keep the tilt. If we see any sustained cross-tenant 4xx or 5xx > thresholds, flip fallback. Otherwise after 30m at 5% we move to 25%. Annotate deploy ticket with `#edge-bridge-v2-rollout` and include the rollback triggers and timestamps.
product-comm: Notes updated and staged. Will ship post-finalize.
Joan C: Thanks team, standing by for operator handoff notes and changelog entry.
ops-night: Watching until 01:30 UTC; will call if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
